title: **Iranian MP: ‘Epstein Creators’ Attack Independent Iran to Defend Their Global Order**
text:
**Iranian MP: ‘Epstein Creators’ Attack Independent Iran to Defend Their Global Order**"

"Sara Fallahi, Chair of the Human Rights Committee of the Iranian Parliament (Majlis), said those who “created Epstein,” committed child sexual abuse, and exploited women in an “economic and sexual cesspit” now claim to be building a world order and are attacking the independent Islamic Republic to protect it."

"Fallahi added that they “martyr” Iran’s leader, scientists, commanders, and innocent children, women, and youth while claiming to have protected human rights and confronted weapons of mass destruction. She said U.S. claims therefore carry no credibility among societies that “know and understand.”"

"Fallahi also said she hopes the true nature of America will be exposed to Iranian society and that conditions can one day be created in the world where those who are “anti-human” and “slaughter human ethics” are hanged for their crimes instead of remaining in politics.
